research_scope: Review groups derived from frozen 487 target cohort; not independent approved Projects

method.rows: Read outputs/project_entity_register.csv, preserve its 39 rows, sort by canonical_name ascending (English locale); copy entity_id,canonical_name,state_or_territory,inclusion_gate,stage_status,location_status,company_history_status
method.human_signoff_recorded: YES only if reviewer_decision is non-empty; all 39 were NO
method.stage_signal_only: PASS_CONSTRUCTION -> OUTSIDE_SCOPE_SIGNAL_CONSTRUCTION; PASS_FEASIBILITY or PASS_EXPLORATION_AND_PFS -> IN_WINDOW_SIGNAL_PENDING_DATED_CONFIRMATION; otherwise AMBIGUOUS_STAGE_TAG_REVIEW_REQUIRED
method.other_assessment_fields: PENDING_INDEPENDENT_APPROVAL or NOT_AUDITED_IN_GROUP_REGISTER/NOT_VALIDATED_FROM_DATED_SOURCE/NOT_AUDITED_AND_NOT_APPROVED; no new approval assigned
method.C1_release_status: C1_NOT_RELEASED for every review group; no official C1 cohort frozen

limitations: CSV is a screening audit derived only from archived repository files, not a fresh JORC/company/tenure document review. Git blob SHA are Git object identifiers, not source-document SHA256.
